metadata.title: create-windows-iso-with-apjson
metadata.description: Creates a Windows 10/11 ISO using the latest download and auto-injects Autopilot JSON

findings.title: Dynamic PowerShell code execution
findings.description: Dynamic evaluation can make a script harder to inspect and may enable downloaded or constructed code to run.

evidence.snippet: Change: Replaced invoke-expression to work with PS7

findings.title: Network retrieval combined with code execution
findings.description: The same file contains both a network retrieval pattern and a dynamic execution pattern. This combination merits review and is not by itself proof of malicious intent.

evidence.snippet: $response = Invoke-RestMethod -Method Post -Uri https://login.microsoftonline.com/$Tenant/oauth2/v2.0/token -Body $body  …  Change: Replaced invoke-expression to work with PS7

findings.title: Plain text is converted to a secure string
findings.description: File 'file-00001.ps1' uses ConvertTo-SecureString with plaintext. This will expose secure information. Encrypted standard strings should be used instead.
